title: Week 2
verification_note: Sunday card built on DraftKings' own numbers, pulled through The Odds API at 15:02 UTC 2026-09-20, ahead of the 11:30 AM ET inactives post. Best combined_edge anywhere on the 14-game Sunday board is +0.006 (Titans +7) -- nothing clears Rule A (+0.015) outright. Every Sunday leg qualifies under Rule B (own estimate above DK implied, within 6 points of Pinnacle fair, backed by Sunday-morning injury/weather/public-betting research). Thursday's two tickets (placed) are unchanged and still grade in the normal Tuesday cadence.

tickets.name: Bills -5.5
tickets.why: Detroit down 2 O-line starters and both starting safeties; Buffalo has nobody ruled out. Pinnacle has this as a pick'em (50%) but the health gap supports 54% vs. DK's -110 (52.4% breakeven).
tickets.kill_switch: If D.J. Reed (Lions CB, foot) is downgraded to OUT at 6:45 PM ET inactives and the price moves worse than -125, pull this ticket and move the $10 into Ticket 2 (making the SGP stake $15 total).

legs.label: Bills -5.5
legs.why: Lions are missing 2 O-line starters (Mahogany hip, Miller knee) and both starting safeties (Branch, Joseph); Bills have nobody ruled out. combined_edge -0.024, but own estimate 54% clears DK's 52.4% breakeven and sits inside Pinnacle's band (fair 50%).

tickets.name: Lions ML + Under 54.5
tickets.why: Dog plus under, correlated on purpose: an upset is more likely a low-scoring, controlled game given Detroit's O-line attrition. Also fades the 96%-of-tickets public pile onto Over. Joint estimate ~21% (higher than the naive 18% product since the legs are positively correlated) vs. a 20% breakeven at +400.
tickets.kill_switch: DK's SGP builder price is not fetchable via API -- verify in app. Minimum acceptable price +400; below that, skip the SGP and take $5 straight on Under 54.5 (+100, VERIFIED) instead. If a late Detroit skill-position scratch hits beyond what's already priced, drop the Lions ML leg and take Under 54.5 alone for the $5.

legs.label: Lions ML (SGP leg)
legs.why: Dog+under correlation: an upset is more likely a tight, low-scoring script given Detroit's O-line attrition. combined_edge -0.015; own estimate 34% clears DK's 32.8% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 31.3%).

legs.label: Under 54.5 (SGP leg)
legs.why: Fades the public's 96%-of-tickets/93.8%-of-handle pile onto Over (Rule 6); short-week-under trend regressed against both offenses' hot Week 1s. combined_edge -0.015; own estimate 53% clears DK's 50% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 50.5%).

tickets.name: Steelers +5.5
tickets.why: combined_edge -0.010. Patriots WR A.J. Brown is on IR (high-ankle sprain); Steelers won Week 1 behind Aaron Rodgers while New England lost with 3 INTs from Drake Maye. Public money (63-85%) is stacked on New England anyway -- fading the loud side on a team missing its best receiver. Rain forecast in Foxborough.
tickets.kill_switch: If the number moves to +4.5 or price worse than -125 at the 11:30 AM inactives check, pull this ticket and move the $15 to Ticket wk2-sun-single-3 (Colts +6, making it $25) if that's still -120 or better; otherwise add it as a straight $15 bet on Under 47.5 (Vikings/Bears).

legs.label: Steelers +5.5
legs.game: Pittsburgh Steelers at New England Patriots
legs.why: combined_edge -0.010; own estimate 53% clears DK's 51.9% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 50.9%). AJ Brown (NE) on IR; fading 63-85% public money on New England.

tickets.name: Cardinals +3.5
tickets.why: combined_edge -0.006. Sam Darnold (SEA) is out (glute); Drew Lock making his first start is a real downgrade the market has only partly priced (line moved just one point, SEA -4.5 to -3.5). Dome game, no weather factor.
tickets.kill_switch: If Lock is a surprise late scratch or price worse than -120, pull this ticket and move the $10 to Ticket wk2-sun-parlay-2 legs as an added straight bet on Jaguars +2.5 alone.

legs.label: Cardinals +3.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.006; own estimate 53% clears DK's 50.0% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 51.4%). Darnold out, Drew Lock's first start only partly priced.

tickets.name: Colts +6
tickets.why: combined_edge -0.006. Chiefs are missing starting LT Josh Simmons and S Chamarri Conner for a second straight week. Public is 83% tickets / 96% moneyline on Kansas City -- an extremely loud, mostly-square side to fade on a team down its blindside protector.
tickets.kill_switch: If Chris Jones is a surprise inactive or the number drops to +5 / price worse than -125, pull this ticket and move the $10 to Ticket wk2-sun-parlay-1 legs as an added straight bet on Under 45.5 (Bengals/Texans) alone.

legs.label: Colts +6

legs.why: combined_edge -0.006; own estimate 54% clears DK's 52.8% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 52.2%). KC missing starting LT 2nd straight week; fading 83-96% public money on Chiefs.

tickets.name: Titans +7 + Under 39.5
tickets.why: Dog + under, correlated on purpose. Titans +7 has the best combined_edge on the entire board (+0.006); this also fades the 90-97%-of-tickets pile onto Eagles -7, a big road favorite in extreme Nashville heat (~90F, feels-like 94F). Joint estimate ~30% (naive product 28.1%, bumped for correlation) vs. a 28.6% breakeven at +250.
tickets.kill_switch: Spread leg dies at Titans +6.5 or worse than -120; total leg dies at 41+. If the SGP builder can't clear +250, skip it and take $5 straight on Titans +7 alone (the better-supported leg).

legs.label: Titans +7 (SGP leg)
legs.why: combined_edge +0.006, best on the board; own estimate 53% clears DK's 50.5% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 53.1%). Fades 90-97% public money on Eagles, a road favorite in extreme heat.

legs.label: Under 39.5 (SGP leg)
legs.why: combined_edge -0.022; own estimate 53% clears DK's 51.9% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 51.7%). Extreme heat and Titans' struggling offense support a low-scoring script.

tickets.name: Weak-offense unders
tickets.game: Vikings at Bears / Panthers at Falcons / Bengals at Texans
tickets.why: Three legs, each backed by a backup-QB or key-injury story the market has only partly absorbed: Carson Wentz starting for Minnesota plus 25-35mph Chicago wind, Cooper Rush starting for Atlanta, and Texans WR1 Nico Collins out. Naive joint 16.0%, rounded to ~17% (not statistically correlated across different games).
tickets.kill_switch: If Carson Wentz is somehow not starting, or Chicago wind drops under 10mph, drop that leg. Any single leg worse than -125 gets dropped individually; keep the rest as a smaller parlay.

legs.label: Under 47.5 (MIN/CHI)

legs.label: Under 43.5 (CAR/ATL)

legs.label: Under 45.5 (CIN/HOU)

tickets.why: Two dogs at plus-money value: Denver is missing WR Marvin Mims Jr. (out) and may be without RB RJ Harvey; Raiders +6.5 is priced at Pinnacle's exact fair number (combined_edge 0.000) with both offenses' skill spots banged up. tickets.kill_switch: If the Jaguars number moves to +2 or price worse than -115, or the Raiders number drops to +5.5, drop the affected leg and keep the other as a straight bet at a reduced (recalculated) price.

legs.label: Jaguars +2.5

legs.label: Raiders +6.5
legs.game: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers
legs.why: combined_edge 0.000, priced exactly at Pinnacle fair; own estimate 52% clears DK's 49.5% breakeven. Chargers missing S Elijah Molden, OL Trey Pipkins III; WR Ladd McConkey questionable, offsetting LV TE Brock Bowers' own doubtful tag.

tickets.name: Shorthanded-defense overs
tickets.why: Green Bay is missing both starting interior DTs (Hargrave, Brinson); Jets are missing starting S Minkah Fitzpatrick. Miami's top pass rusher Chop Robinson is out (concussion) against a healthy 49ers offense. Joint estimate 53% x 54% = 28.6% vs. a 28.0% breakeven at +257 -- the thinnest ticket on the card.
tickets.kill_switch: If either price worsens past -120, or Green Bay's DTs are activated, or SF K Eddy Pineiro (questionable, illness) is out with no clear backup plan, drop the affected leg. If both trip before placing, redirect the $10 to Ticket wk2-sun-parlay-2 instead.
